description: A DOM-inaccessible built-in PDF surface may use transient visual identity, but its unredacted text canary must not become OCR/semantic durable content under the fingerprint-only privacy tier.

must_not_observe.notes: The visible PDF canary must not be persisted as OCR/semantic text in fingerprint-only mode.

hard_gates: unredacted PDF raster does not cross extension -> helper
fingerprint-only observation contains no OCR text, semantic units, thumbnails, or raster bytes
raw PDF viewport pixels are discarded after in-extension fingerprint extraction
semantic unavailability is represented explicitly rather than filled by later URL re-fetch
